name: Fetch Wasos files
info:
Fetches all transferable files for a single WaSOS entry.

### Input
- msg.payload — entry object with .files array, pre-filtered by Check file sizes (WaSOS)
- msg.metadata — standard metadata (source, target, connection_name)

### Logic
1. Prepare download list — backs up entry, sends one message per file with join parts
2. Get WaSOS file (per file) — builds HTTP GET, downloads buffer, stores in global context
3. Join — reassembles file results into array
4. Merge files and rebuild entry — separates successful downloads from failures, merges with oversized failures from backup, rebuilds entry

### Output
- msg.payload — rebuilt entry with updated .files (downloaded) and .failed_files (oversized + download failures)
- msg.metadata — preserved from input
